name: Lilith no Sono
source:
This all girls school has had a tradition since before the war.
New student Lilith Kinomiya is given her initiation tour.
A romantic girl-meets-girl story!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ093958?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这所女子学校，有一项战前便已存在的传统。
新生木之宫莉莉丝，正接受入学导览。
一个女孩与女孩相遇的浪漫故事！
